name: py_sysctl_regs
desc: py_soc system control: reset cause, boot status, cycle counter, SoC ID, core logic reset, clock enables, timer compare interrupt.

registers.name: RESET_CAUSE
registers.desc: cause of the last reset (sticky across system resets, cleared by the external reset only); write 1 to clear

registers.name: CORE_RESET
registers.desc: 1 = release the reset of the logic outside py_soc (cleared by every system reset)

fields.name: LOCKED
fields.desc: outputs locked (1 without a clock generator)

registers.name: TIMER_CMP
registers.desc: timer compare: STATUS.REACHED is set when CYCLES reaches this value (CYCLES - TIMER_CMP < 2**31, wrap-safe); the CPU's timeouts and timed waits sleep on it

registers.name: TIMER_STATUS
registers.desc: timer status (the logic's flag); write 1 to clear

fields.name: REACHED
fields.desc: CYCLES reached TIMER_CMP: one-shot, armed by every TIMER_CMP write (which clears it), set in the clock CYCLES equals TIMER_CMP (in the clock after the write when it is already reached: CYCLES - TIMER_CMP < 2**31); write 1 to clear (a set in the same clock wins)
